author: LachezarVoynov
seen: A 2-minute Pixar-style 3D music video sung in the first person by a woman in her 50s, with word-highlighted lyric captions and roughly 3-second shots. It opens on the wound ("Last night my husband asked me to keep my shirt on / 22 years of marriage"), flashes back to young love, shows the slow fade (the new job, his phone face down), blames her crepey arm skin, runs through failed fixes ($180 firming cream, collagen coffee, dry brush), and stops as her sister arrives with the answer. It was edited end to end by an AI agent pipeline (Nano Banana stills, Kling 3.0 animation, Suno song).
